name: Brandhero
description: Brandhero is a design agency that specializes in UI/UX design, branding, and product design. They provide services such as UX research, design strategy, and development to help businesses create digital products that drive meaningful impact.

capabilities.name: UI/UX Design
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers UI/UX design services that include user experience research, design strategy, and development. They help businesses create digital products that are user-friendly, visually appealing, and effective in driving business outcomes.

capabilities.name: Branding
capabilities.description: Brandhero provides branding services that include brand identity design, visual design, and tone of voice development. They help businesses create a strong brand identity that resonates with their target audience and drives business growth.

capabilities.name: Product Design
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers product design services that include product strategy, design research, and development. They help businesses create digital products that are innovative, user-friendly, and effective in driving business outcomes.

capabilities.name: UX Research
capabilities.description: Brandhero provides UX research services that include user experience research, usability testing, and user interviews. They help businesses understand their users' needs and behaviors, and create digital products that meet those needs.

capabilities.name: Design Strategy
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers design strategy services that include design strategy development, design visioning, and design roadmap creation. They help businesses create a design strategy that aligns with their business goals and drives business outcomes.

capabilities.name: Development
capabilities.description: Brandhero provides development services that include front-end development, back-end development, and full-stack development. They help businesses bring their digital products to life and ensure they are scalable and maintainable.

capabilities.name: Agile UX
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers Agile UX services that include iterative design, user feedback, and continuous improvement. They help businesses create digital products that are user-friendly, visually appealing, and effective in driving business outcomes.

capabilities.name: Accessibility Compliance
capabilities.description: Brandhero provides accessibility compliance services that include accessibility testing, accessibility auditing, and accessibility remediation. They help businesses ensure their digital products are accessible to all users, including those with disabilities.

capabilities.name: Behavioral Analytics
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers behavioral analytics services that include user behavior analysis, user journey mapping, and user experience optimization. They help businesses understand their users' behavior and create digital products that meet their needs.

capabilities.name: Design Trends
capabilities.description: Brandhero provides design trend analysis services that include design trend research, design trend forecasting, and design trend implementation. They help businesses stay up-to-date with the latest design trends and create digital products that are innovative and effective.

capabilities.name: Design Portfolio
capabilities.description: Brandhero offers design portfolio services that include design portfolio development, design portfolio optimization, and design portfolio maintenance. They help businesses create a strong design portfolio that showcases their design capabilities and drives business growth.
